description: Carbon intensity (forecast gCO2/kWh + index band) and generation mix for a specific Great Britain region. Pass "postcode" (UK outcode — first half of a postcode, e.g. "RG10") or "regionid" (1–17, e.g. 13 = London). Omit both for all regions at the current half-hour. Regional figures are forecast-only.

postcode.description: UK outcode (first part of a postcode), e.g. "RG10". No spaces.

name: get_regional_intensity
